title: Taint analysis (SQL, command, path, deserialization, HTML, log)
summary: taint-sql-injection, taint-command-injection taint-path-traversal, taint-deserialization, taint-html-output and taint-log follow index data_flows facts from a source to a sink
intro: Read this when you want to find tainted values reaching a SQL, command or file-path sink across routines and units. The rules run in lint-all and in lint with a store; the catalogues of sources, sinks and propagators are editable JSON.
